It's been about a week since the last update and, during that time, I learned so much about CSS. I came back to this project and cringed at how messy the code was. I started going over the code and organizing each element manually. That lasted for a few hours until I was fed up. It was time to hit the 'RESET' button and re-write the entire code with a more CSS-mature mindset.

After about 16 hours of straight codework, I finally finished most of the re-write. I am proud to announce that I cut off a whopping 3,000 characters of code, improved the look, and made the theme play better.

There is still a big part of the theme that needs to be added and that's the new customization platform. I have an idea for one that will greatly improve the previous, so-called 'customization' aspect that I had before. I also need to add documentation for it — I'm talking complete documentation for both CSS noobs and masters alike.

It's exciting, but it's going to take a while to do; probably more than the actual re-write. But, it'll be worth it.

So, I wanted to release a pre-release for v2.0 to give you guys a look at the theme while I finish off the platform and documentation. Also, if you find any issues with the theme, you can report it on the theme's Github repo and/or on this sub so it doesn't make it past release. :)

Anyway, it's bedtime for me. Happy whoaversing!
